Emission by the compiler's build state (so this file is generated) is still open.

calibrations.basis: 2026-11-04, amu fe5d4855a seed compiler, desktop profile. The compiler's cumulative code extent (E7104 detail) was measured at the boundary with a padding module: extent 2,097,474 at 30 padding arms, KERNEL.ELF text filesz 2,107,648 at 26 arms, about 100 bytes per arm, so filesz - extent is about 10,570 (+-100). 10,400 is used so that the estimated margin errs low. Six KERNEL.ELF text sizes (2,093,824 .. 2,107,648) are consistent with it.

2026-11-04, amu f0e1358af + JUN-811 (kernel-v3 text cap 2.5 MiB). The only compiler change is the cap constant: the 4-app desktop kernel it builds from the unchanged kotoba sources is byte-identical to the one built by 2387a32d (KERNEL.ELF text filesz 2,093,824, same desktop build receipt hash e4a6f3e9af84...), so the filesz - extent overhead measured for 2387a32d applies unchanged.

2026-11-06, amu 385bab044 (JUN-854: kernel-v3 text cap 3 MiB less 64 KiB reserve). The only compiler change is the cap constant: the mldsa-verify desktop kernel built from kotoba ca6a880d4 sources with this compiler is byte-identical to the one built by c126449b (KERNEL.ELF sha256 3e37c2fe4358..., text filesz 2,259,456), so the filesz - extent overhead measured for 2387a32d applies unchanged. The new cap itself was not exercised with a kernel above 2.5 MiB.
